name: K2000
tagline: 80s synthwave and darksynth synth with 6 waveforms, a ladder filter and 70 presets.
gumroad_title: K2000 - 80s Synthwave Synthesizer VST3 + AU Plugin (70 Presets) | Synthwave, Darksynth
summary: An 80s synthwave and darksynth synthesizer plugin (VST3 and Audio Unit) with six waveforms, five filter modes, an LFO with its own envelope, built-in effects and 70 factory presets.
about: K2000, sold under the HUMPIRE brand by DJBILBOX BEATS, generates every sound in real time with no samples. Choose one of six waveforms (Sawtooth, Square, Triangle, Sine, SuperSaw and 80s Brass), shape it with a filter that has five modes, including a 24 dB ladder and an Acid low pass, then add the master effects: distortion, chorus, ping-pong delay and reverb.

An LFO with its own ADSR envelope can move cutoff, pitch, pulse width, volume, chorus or pan. Pitch bend and modulation wheels, glide and four voice modes (Poly 8, Poly 16, Mono Retrig and Mono Legato) cover chords, leads and bass lines, with up to 16 voices.
70 factory presets in seven banks cover leads, basses, pads, plucks and arps, keys and brass, and FX. Built for Synthwave, Darksynth, Retrowave, Synthpop and Outrun productions.

features.d: Sawtooth, Square, Triangle, Sine, SuperSaw (seven detuned saws) and 80s Brass.
LowPass 24dB ladder, LowPass 12dB, BandPass, HighPass and Acid LowPass, with resonance, drive and a filter envelope.
Seven banks: VOL.1 Factory, Leads, Bass, Pads, Plucks & Arps, Keys & Brass and FX & Atmos.
Six shapes and six destinations: Cutoff, Pitch, Pulse Width, Volume, Chorus and Pan.
Distortion, stereo chorus, ping-pong tape-style delay and reverb, ending in a soft limiter.
Poly 8, Poly 16, Mono Retrig and Mono Legato, with glide and up to 16 voices.
Pitch bend and modulation wheels, plus BANK and ADSR velocity controls.
Everything you make with it is yours.

specs.v: Up to 16 voices (Poly 8, Poly 16), or Mono

includes: K2000 plugin (Windows VST3; macOS VST3 + Audio Unit)

faq.q: Which DAWs does it work in?
faq.a: It is a VST3 instrument on Windows and macOS, plus Audio Unit on macOS. It is designed for FL Studio and should load in any host that supports these formats.

faq.q: Can I save my own presets?
faq.a: Yes. The disk icon saves a .k2preset file, and your presets appear in the User submenu of the preset menu.
